description: We would be delighted to welcome you to our apartment featuring 4 bedrooms, located just steps from the Luxembourg Gardens and the iconic cafés of Saint-Germain-des-Prés.The spaceThis stunning 135 m² apartment is located on the ground floor.It is composed of:On the first level:- A fully equipped kitchen, including a refrigerator, induction hob, toaster, Nespresso coffee machine, kettle, washer-dryer, dishwasher, etc.- A beautiful, minimalist living area featuring a sofa, a TV, a side table, and a dining table that seats 10 people.- A first bedroom for 2 guests with a queen-size bed (160x200) and a walk-in closet.- A second bedroom for 2 guests with a queen-size bed (160x200).- one modern bathroom with double showers, bathtub, sinks, heated towel rail, and toilet.- one modern bathroom with shower, sinks, and heated towel rail.- a separate toilet.On the upper level:- A third bedroom for 4 guests with two double beds (140x200) and a walk-in closet.- A fourth bedroom for 2 guests with a double bed (140x200) and a walk-in closet.- One modern bathroom with shower, sinks, and heated towel rail.- One modern bathroom with shower, double sinks, heated towel rail, and toilet.Additional features:- TV and high-speed Internet (WiFi)- Ample storage space- Welcome amenities: Typology shampoo and shower gel provided- Bed linen and towels providedGuest accessMetro:Vavin (line 4) – a 3-minute walk: direct access to Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Châtelet, and Gare du NordNotre-Dame-des-Champs (line 12) – a 4-minute walk: connects to Montparnasse, Saint-Lazare, and PigalleTrain:Gare Montparnasse – an 8-minute walk: long-distance trains + metro connections (lines 4, 6, 12, 13)Bus:Line 58 – towards Châtelet, Luxembourg, and VanvesLine 82 – towards the Eiffel Tower, Invalides, and LuxembourgLine 91
